title: Economics/Assistant Professor/Three Year Term
description:
Position Title: Economics/Assistant Professor/Three Year
Term

Department: Economics

Term of Assignment: Three Year Term

Term End Date, If Applicable: May 7, 2030

FLSA Status: Exempt = not eligible for overtime

Salary: Competitive

Travel: No travel

Brief Statement of Duties

Brief Statement of Duties: Teach courses in Money and
Banking, Intermediate Macroeconomics, Principles of Macroeconomics,
and be prepared to teach Introduction to Economics and Principles
of Microeconomics. The normal teaching load is three courses (12
credit hours) per semester, with up to three different course
preparations per semester. Additional responsibilities include
service at the department, college, and university levels, and
student advising. Resources are available for engaging in
professional development, research, and conference travel. This
position is campus-based and is not currently eligible for
sponsorship.

Minimum Qualifications

Required Education: Doctorate or equivalent terminal
degree

Discipline/Degree Area: Economics

Required Specialized Training/Certifications:

Required Minimum Work Experience: Ph.D. in Economics from an
accredited institution must be completed by August 15, 2027.
Evidence of teaching effectiveness and a track record of scholarly
activity.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, or Attributes Required for
Satisfactory Performance of the Position Duties:

Ability to communicate both orally and in writing.
Demonstrated ability to develop and teach courses in
economics.
Demonstrated excellence in undergraduate teaching and commitment to
engaged mentorship and student development.
Initiative in program development and continuous improvement.
Time management skills.

Additional Desirable Qualifications

Additional Desirable Qualifications:

Being able to teach Comparative Economic Systems and American
Economic History.
Being able to integrate emerging technologies, including AI, into
teaching and other professional activities in innovative and
effective ways.

Other

Special Instructions to Applicants: Applicant materials will
include a faculty application, cover letter, CV/Resume, and
unofficial transcripts.

Contact Information: Hugo Eyzaguirre

NMU is an equal opportunity employer.
